knownLimits: No daemon, heartbeats, scheduler, UI, or notifications: leases expire only when observed by a later operation against the injected/real clock.
Dirty Git observations are timestamped evidence, not immutable snapshots; file assertions and check outcomes are agent-reported and never executed.
Claims guard task ownership, not file paths: concurrent edits to one project need separate worktrees or disjoint files supplied by the user.
Review-mode omission happens in core selection: review snapshots contain no question bodies and no handoff narratives in either JSON or rendered text.
Decision relevance is exact path match only: no fuzzy search or embeddings.
Context caps are 20 per section with explicit omitted counts; inbox paging uses limit+1 with nextCursor/hasMore and never consumes.
Receipt clash between identical concurrent mutations replays the winner; a reused key with different content is CONFLICT.
State directories on network/shared filesystems are unsupported; WAL/SHM stay inside the 0700 home with a 0600 database file.
transactionBoundaries: Every mutation: dispatch receipt pre-check, then one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction holding recheck, state checks, writes, inbox events, and receipt insert; any error rolls back all effects including the receipt.
Git discovery (project.register) and Git observation (handoff.submit, context currentGit) always run outside transactions; handoff retries replay from receipts without new Git collection.
Reads never write: task.get/list, inbox.list, and context selection (single read transaction for snapshots) mutate nothing.
Concurrent startup serializes on BEGIN IMMEDIATE during migrations; lock exhaustion surfaces as BUSY, never raw SQLite errors.
